title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

title: Baazi
desc: A chief minister delegates the task of locating culprits behind a scandal to a police inspector with a reputation for tackling assassins. However, the inspector is framed for murder and must find a way to prove himself innocent.

title: Diary Of A Butterfly
desc: Gul, an aspiring model, wants to make it big in the fashion industry and decides to leave no stone unless turned to achieve success. However, she soon realises that success comes at a price

title: Emi Liya Hai To Chukana Padega
desc: A film that tells the story of a group of people who fall prey to credit card debt and are struggling to repay their loans. They come together to form a support group and devise a plan to fight against the corrupt practices of the credit card companies. The movie highlights the consequences of reckless spending and the importance of financial literacy in an engaging and thought-provoking plot.
